tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every route except the player's colour field.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, session rows, the owner sheet, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover state of surface items; nested panels inside a sheet.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Slider tracks, mood-bar tracks, copy fields, code.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, switches off, secondary buttons). At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, hints, on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Warm brand hue. Fill of the one primary action per view (Start listening, Save). Text on it is on-glow, never white.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a glow fill.

tokens.name: glow-ink
tokens.usage: Warm hue as text: clamp notes and the 'limited' tag, on surface, bg and glow-soft.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Background of clamp notes and the 'limited' tag, behind glow-ink.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Cool brand hue. Links, selected state, slider fill, switch on, the intent bar, the live dot. As text, on bg, surface and tide-soft.

tokens.name: on-tide
tokens.usage: Text and the switch knob on a tide fill.

tokens.name: tide-soft
tokens.usage: Selected background of choices and segments; 'live' tag background, behind tide text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (End session, Delete, Revoke) as text and border on surface. Always paired with a verb, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (confirm dialogs).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error message, behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of tide, 3:1 or more on every surface and on the scrim.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent panel under every control that sits on the colour field (control bar, reaction grid, start button frame). Same in both themes: on-scrim text holds 5:1 even over a white field.

tokens.name: scrim-line
tokens.usage: Hairline border of a scrim panel.

tokens.name: scrim-fill
tokens.usage: Resting fill of buttons on the scrim (mute, reactions).

tokens.name: scrim-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of buttons on the scrim.

tokens.name: on-scrim
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the scrim, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-scrim-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the scrim (status line metadata). 4.9:1 over the worst case (white field under the scrim).

tokens.name: on-scrim-inverse
tokens.usage: Icon on an on-scrim fill: the pressed (muted) state of the mute button.

tokens.name: tide-scrim
tokens.usage: Tide on the scrim, in both themes: focus ring, slider fill, live dot and selected state for controls on the colour field. 4:1 or more over the worst case.

tokens.name: field-a
tokens.usage: Colour field before the first state arrives: gradient start. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: field-b
tokens.usage: Colour field before the first state arrives: gradient end.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Roboto, from Google Fonts (400, 500, 700). Everything a person reads as language.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Let the model hum while it thinks
styles.usage: Landing page hero only. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside pages and the owner sheet.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sound and colour reach you before anything can be softened, so you set the limits.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, one-line explanations under choices, helper text.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, from Google Fonts (400, 500, 600). Everything the machine says: numbers, settings, URLs, the status line.

styles.name: data
styles.sample: listening · turn 12 · last change 4 s ago
styles.usage: Status line, slider values, session metadata.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Tags, clamp notes, mood-bar labels and values, timeline.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase group labels above sections. Set in uppercase in the markup's CSS, not in the text.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark, always lowercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap inside a control row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a bar or row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet padding; the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of the owner sheet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above page titles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, clamp notes, copy fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, reaction buttons, choices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, scrim panels, the owner sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Start listening, mute, switches, slider tracks, mood bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The owner sheet as it slides up.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the 'copied' / 'sent' confirmation.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on the player (mute, reactions). The player is used one-handed on a phone.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on regular pages.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the player's control bar.

tokens.name: ui-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: ui
tokens.usage: Sheet slide, control bar fade-in.

tokens.name: bar-idle
tokens.usage: Idle time before the control bar fades out.

tokens.name: reaction-cooldown
tokens.usage: A reaction button stays disabled this long after a press.

tokens.name: glide-reduced
tokens.usage: Minimum colour glide under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: flash-min-period
tokens.usage: Hard floor for any brightness cycle in the colour field (no faster than 3 Hz). Not configurable.
